user.title: Connect to the device
user.description: Connects to a Hikvision access-control device (e.g. a door station like the Metzler VDM10) via ISAPI with Digest authentication.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the device.
data_description.verify_ssl: Only relevant when HTTPS is enabled.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter credentials
reauth_confirm.description: The device rejected the stored credentials repeatedly. Enter the current ones.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the device
error.timeout_connect: The device did not answer in time

abort.unique_id_mismatch: This is a different device than the one originally configured

data_description.poll_interval: How often the access event log is polled. Lower means faster reaction.
data_description.mask_card_data: Show only the last digits of card and employee numbers in entity attributes. Recorder history, backups and screenshots then never contain the full numbers.
data_description.door_pulse_seconds: Used for relay-style door commands that need an explicit off.
